0x00081E.en: 「With my skills as they are now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x00088F.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000917.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A40.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...!?」

0x000A78.en: 「Well, well...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B7C.en: 「You think I'd screw up here...!@　This isn't funny...」

0x000BD0.en: 「I blew it...!@　Guess I've got no choice but to bail...」

0x000D21.en: 「So this is it... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DCD.en: 「No good, I've taken too much damage... I'm pulling out!」

0x000E1A.en: 「What a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E58.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E9F.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F4A.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who falls like a meteor... I'm ejecting!」

0x001001.en: 「Ow ow ow... I'm beaten. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x001086.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x00113A.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x00116F.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x00125B.en: 「To be taken down here...@ I've still got so far to go...!」

0x0012A9.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001393.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013D1.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001400.en: 「I can do no more. Allow me to take my leave.」

0x00148B.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0016AF.en: 「Gaaah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00181E.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x00198E.en: 「Contact with the Hagane and the Stork-class is lost!@ We have no visual either!」

0x0019EA.en: 「That abnormal gravity reading and ES wave earlier...!?」

0x001A30.en: 「Unmeasurable...!@ Also, a powerful low-pressure system is forming overhead!」

0x001A9C.en: 「But this is no mere freak weather.@ It's as if... night itself has fallen...!」

0x001B1C.en: 「What about the Satellite Link...!?@ Can't we trace the Hagane's position with it?」

0x001BD4.en: 「If the ES wave came from the direction of the South Pole,@ then the cause is the Ruina...」

0x001C39.en: 「High-speed objects inbound! Straight on, dead ahead!@ Identified: mass-produced Huckebein Mk-II! Nine of them!」

0x001CE1.en: 「Federation pursuers.@ And we can't move a muscle right now.」

0x001D2E.en: 「Eun, any word from Joint Chiefs of Staff HQ?」

0x001D62.en: 「About that... I can't get a signal through.」

0x001DAC.en: 「Turned away at the gate, are we.」

0x001DEA.en: 「...All hands, hold as you are.@ Absolutely no firing on our part.@ Rush the emergency repairs on the Tesla Drive.」

0x001EA5.en: 「Captain, friendly units will enter visual range shortly.」

0x001EE8.en: 「...Understood. We'll see how they play it.」

0x001F28.en: 「What the hell is with that sky?@ Doesn't look like it's covered in clouds.」

0x001F8D.en: 「And I sure didn't hear anything about@ a total solar eclipse...」

0x00200E.en: 「Are we... going to end up fighting@ our own allies...!?」

0x002061.en: 「My motto's to never turn down a fight,@ but this time...」

0x0020C4.en: 「Hiryu Kai, tally-ho.@ Depending on how they react, we attack. Understood?」

0x002148.en: 「...I've detected an ESM. They mean business.」

0x002198.en: 「Then, until the Tesla Drive repairs are done,@ I'll talk to them and buy us time.」

0x002215.en: 「...Captain, you seriously mean to tangle with the Steel Dragon Squadron?@ They wrecked the <White Star> along with the@ <Inspectors>, didn't they?」

0x0022C4.en: 「That's not the half of it.@ Word is they took down the leader of the Shura too.」

0x00232A.en: 「It's just rumor. But on top of that,@ they've got not just cutting-edge machines, but Einst and@ Demon-derived weapons too.」

0x0023BA.en: 「You think we'll come out of fighting people like that in one piece...!?」

0x002400.en: 「...Captain, the men are getting nervous.@ There's the strange sky, too. Maybe we should...」

0x00247A.en: 「The Steel Dragon Squadron won't lift a finger against us.@ Think of this as a once-in-a-lifetime chance.」

0x0024EB.en: 「Even the famed Gaia Sabers let them escape...@ this would be a huge achievement.@ Pull it off, and we all leave this backwater for good.」

0x0025AB.en: 「Pablo, it'd be easier for you to see your family too.@ You haven't laid eyes on your youngest since@ she started school, right?」

0x00265A.en: 「Do it for your kids' sake, and finish the mission.@ First we issue a demand for surrender. After that...」

0x0026C8.en: 「One o'clock, high heat source underwater!@ It's rising fast!」

0x0027E3.en: 「Y-you bastard! What have you done to my men!!」

0x00281A.en: 「Yes! Aim your rage and hatred at me!@ And give us that surge of negative emotion!」

0x0028CF.en: 「We'll take on the Ruina!@ You get out of here, now!」

0x002947.en: 「Hmph, a nuisance shows up.@ Then I'll send out my own forces.」

0x0029C2.en: 「Heh heh heh, so they've come out.」

0x002A00.en: 「Yeah, I hear the voice again.@ Sympathia's acting strange too.@ Looks like there's a Melior Esse-Esse here...!」

0x002AF8.en: 「...What are you doing?@ You were told to head for the far north.」

0x002B54.en: 「I've made contact with some interesting people.@ Tell them that, Laki.」

0x002BF5.en: （What was that? Who were you talking to?）

0x002C5A.en: 「Yeah.@ There's likely a fourth Melior Esse-Esse in that machine...」

0x002CDB.en: 「...I see, so you're the ones who drove Aquila back.」

0x002D59.en: 「That skin color, those ears... it's not an Earthling!?」

0x002DA6.en: 「But it looks like it's wearing something kimono-like...」

0x002E0B.en: 「Ridiculous eyebrows on that guy!@ What's your name!?」

0x002E65.en: 「I am Ignis... the Melior Esse-Esse of flame.@ Carve the name into your memory, with terror and hatred!」

0x002EDF.en: 「Heh! Don't go talking big, eyebrow freak!」

0x002F28.en: 「Hahaha! Good, that's it, that's the way!@ Get angrier! That becomes our power!」

0x002FB7.en: 「The hell are you?! Are you insane!?」

0x002FF1.en: 「I'll light this world of endless night with the flames of ruin!@ Hahahahaha!!」

0x003053.en: 「World of endless night...?@ Then you're the ones@ who caused this phenomenon?」

0x0030BC.en: 「That's right!@ With no sunlight, the humans will@ know fear and despair!」

0x003125.en: 「And then we, the Ruina, will bring@ ruin upon this world!」

0x003190.en: 「Same as that muscle-head the other day,@ nice and easy to see what he's after.」

0x003207.en: 「Getting rid of the sunlight...@ doing it just here is pointless!」

0x003269.en: 「Hahaha! You still don't get it!?@ This whole planet is sealed in darkness!」

0x0032F3.en: 「You expect me to believe such nonsense?」

0x00332D.en: 「Then look at the sky! No stars, right!?@ That's proof enough!」

0x0033AB.en: 「Earth sealed in darkness...!?@ By the Ruina!?」

0x003417.en: 「You don't have to believe it!@ Die here and it won't matter to you anyway!@ Hahaha!」

0x00348F.en: 「You bastard,@ keep the jokes to that face of yours!」

0x0034DC.en: 「Dragon 2 to all units.@ This ship is mid-repair on the Tesla Drive and cannot move.@ Prioritize eliminating enemies approaching us.」

0x00358A.en: 「You heard the man, boys!@ Don't let a single enemy near the Hiryu!」

0x00360B.en: 「Captain, there's an object approaching the combat zone at high speed.」

0x00366A.en: 「Unidentified, and it seems extremely small.@ A missile, or perhaps...」

0x003707.en: 「So it seems we've made it back to our own world.」

0x003757.en: （Riana, look at that! Over there!@　There's someone riding what looks like an air board!）

0x00386F.en: 「'Here too'...!?@　I should be asking where the hell you've been all this time!」

0x0038C5.en: 「Right. Back then, you were with@　Axel Almer and Alfimi...」

0x003931.en: 「Yeah, a lot happened. Thing is,@　I've got no idea how I even wound up@　in a place like this myself...」

0x0039E6.en: 「Yeah, fair enough.@　Anyway, if there's a fight, count me in!」

0x003A3C.en: 「Th-that kid means to fight in that thing!?」

0x003A7F.en: 「It's fine. He's Fighter Roar...@　in that armor, he can go toe to toe@　with mobile weapons.」

0x003AF7.en: 「Yeah! Even without Compati Kaiser,@　I'll get it done!」

0x003B81.en: 「Right back at ya! What's with the getup!?@　Think you're in a samurai flick!?」

0x003BCB.en: 「Hmph. I am Ignis, of the Fires of Melior Esse.」

0x003C61.en: 「Too much of a mouthful. I'll just call ya Messe!」

0x003C92.en: 「Hah, brave words!@　But my flames will be your end!」

0x003D03.en: 「Get bent! When it comes to fire,@　I don't plan on losing!」

0x003D93.en: 「So you're the source of the noise! An eyesore!」

0x003DD3.en: 「Answer me! What is the "King of Ruin"!?」

0x003E13.en: 「You've no need to know!@　You'll die trembling, suffering, in despair!」

0x003EDD.en: 「What is this thing...? Is it mixed together?」

0x003F45.en: 「I fought plenty of weirdos in that other world...@　and over here I get an eyebrow samurai!」

0x003FBF.en: 「Hahaha! Yes, twist that face in terror!!」

0x00402D.en: 「That doubt breeds still greater fear!@　I can't tell you yet... no, you needn't know!」

0x0040A4.en: 「Then we'll beat you down and@　drag out this "King of Ruin".」

0x0040F4.en: 「Hahaha!@　And when that happens, you will die@　in the deepest terror imaginable!」

0x00415A.en: 「Hah, hahaha! Not bad!@　I'd love to savor your rage and hatred@　a while longer, but...」

0x0041E1.en: 「There's somewhere I must be.@　Until we meet again, humans!」

0x004268.en: 「Don't chase him, Kouta.@　What we need now is information.@　Let's head to the Hiryu Kai.」

0x0042D1.en: 「Y-yeah... you're right.@　The sky's gone pitch black, there's these@　new enemies showing up...」

0x00434C.en: 「I've been sensing it for a while now...@　seems some planet-wide upheaval is underway.」

0x0043C3.en: 「The fact that we ended up in a place like this@　might be connected to that as well.」

0x004469.en: 「XO, how's the emergency repair on the Tesla Drive?」

0x0044A6.en: 「We had a report just now that it's complete.」

0x0044DD.en: 「Then once all units are aboard, we submerge.@　We're pulling out of the combat zone.」

0x00452A.en: 「Hiryu Kai has submerged.@　Captain, shall I report our heading?」

0x004589.en: 「...No, don't.@　Tell them we lost sight of the target.」

0x0045F5.en: 「Back there, the Steel Dragon Squadron@　could've left us and run...」

0x004657.en: 「But they didn't. They let us get away.@　We owe them for that.」

0x0046F0.en: （Did they really stage a rebellion@　and assassinate the President...?）

0x0047A2.en: 「...La Gias?@　No, the world we went to@　wasn't called that.」

0x00480E.en: 「So it was some other world, then...」

0x004848.en: 「Hey, where are Alfimi and Axel?@　Weren't they with you?」

0x0048AD.en: 「Yeah, same as when we came back this way...@　looks like those two ended up somewhere else.」

0x004936.en: 「So you did make it back to this world for sure.」

0x00497C.en: 「I'd say so.@　...More to the point, what happened@　while I was gone?」

0x0049F4.en: 「Plenty happened on our end too.@　The Ki-Machines, the Guests, the Ruina showed up...」

0x004A5C.en: 「And then... President Graien Grusman@　was killed, and we're the ones under suspicion.」

0x004ADC.en: 「Wh-what did you say!? How'd that happen!?」

0x004B1C.en: 「We were most likely framed by the Gaia Sabers.@　But the fact remains, we played right@　into their hands...」

0x004BC4.en: 「And so now the Federation Army's@　after us too...」

0x004C3C.en: 「...The key members are all present.@　Then, please, be seated.」

0x004C95.en: 「Let me explain the current situation.@　To put it plainly, it seems Ignis's@　words were correct.」

0x004D41.en: 「An unidentified barrier...@　we're hypothesizing it's a dimensional rift,@　and it appears to have covered the planet.」

0x004DD4.en: 「The sun, moon, and stars are unseen...@ satellite link's down, and space stations,@ moon, colonies gone silent - same cause, it seems.」

0x004EB5.en: 「So you're saying the Ruina really did cut off@　not just sunlight, but Earth from space itself?」

0x004F4B.en: 「They shrouded Antarctica in an invisible barrier...@　it's hardly beyond the realm of possibility.」

0x004FB0.en: 「What does the Earth look like from space?」

0x004FF9.en: 「This is only a hypothesis, but I'd say it's invisible...@　in other words, it appears to have vanished.」

0x005095.en: 「If Earth and space are cut off by a dimensional rift,@　then we... can't reach space anymore...?」

0x00511E.en: 「We can't be certain without testing it, but...@　we'd either shatter against the rift, or be@　flung off into another dimension.」

0x00520C.en: 「The ES Wave that spread from Antarctica@　passed between the Hagane and the Hiryu Kai.」

0x005277.en: 「Either it was blown clear and thrown@　outside the Earth, or...」

0x0052F5.en: 「Just what the hell is this dimensional rift,@　Cliff...!?」

0x005348.en: 「Once we determine the current shape of the@　geomagnetic shield, we'll know more, but...@　right now I can't say for certain.」

0x0053EA.en: 「So if Earth stays wrapped in this rift like this,@　what's gonna happen to it...!?」

0x005464.en: 「Soon it'll hit the air cycle, then ocean currents.@ The seas hold heat, but land-sea temp gaps will@ spawn fierce storms along the coasts.」

0x005527.en: 「Roughly put, the energy coming into Earth is@　visible light. The energy leaving is far-infrared...」

0x0055B3.en: 「That in-and-out stays balanced, which is what@　keeps Earth's temperature more or less steady.@　If that balance breaks down...」

0x005655.en: 「Snowball Earth...@　in other words, a total global freeze is possible.」

0x0056C4.en: 「Mind you, it won't be tomorrow.@　But there's a problem that'll hit even sooner:@　the power lines.」

0x005764.en: 「That's right...@　With perpetual night and dropping temps, the whole@　world will crank up its lights and heating at once.

0x0057F7.en: 「When that happens, the surge in power demand@　could blow out the power grid.」

0x00585F.en: 「And then... the psychological toll on people.@　Lose the sunlight, and hearts grow restless.@　And that turns into despair...」

0x0058FB.en: 「The one silver lining is that we're@　spared any attacks from the Guests.」

0x005951.en: 「And in their place we've got the Ruina.@　That's no consolation at all.」

0x0059B0.en: 「Either way, if we don't break the rift fast,@　it's exactly what the Ruina want.」

0x005A15.en: 「Damn it, because of my old man... this...!」

0x005A6B.en: 「No use lamenting what's already done.@　What matters is how we set it right.」

0x005AF1.en: 「If the rift is the Ruina's doing, then the key@　to unraveling it lies with them too, doesn't it?」

0x005B77.en: 「Kyosuke's right. Was there anything in that talk@　with the Melior Esse that could be a lead?」

0x005C37.en: 「Right.@　I'm pretty sure he said Raki... the far north.」

0x005C81.en: 「The far north? You mean the Arctic?」

0x005CDD.en: 「...Colonel Lefina, let's hurry to Comodin Island@　to regroup.」

0x005D4E.en: 「We're set to rendezvous with Gilliam there.@　We should be able to get information from him.」

0x005DCF.en: （Th-then that means Father and the others...）

0x005E03.en: （I'm worried about Dad and the rest, but@　if we don't do something about the rift, we can't@　even get back to Antarctica...）

0x005EB2.en: （This situation...@　how am I supposed to set it right, old man...!）
